description: List POLISH government tenders published by a specific contracting authority (zamawiający) — e.g. a city office, a hospital, a ministry — via the official e-Zamówienia / BZP platform (ezamowienia.gov.pl, Urząd Zamówień Publicznych). Case-insensitive substring match against the buyer/organization name within a publish-date window. Returns compact shaped notices with title, order type, CPV codes, submission deadline, and notice URL — useful for "what is <city/agency> currently buying".

buyer.description: Contracting-authority name, partial match, Polish spelling, e.g. "Urząd Miasta Gdańsk", "Szpital Uniwersytecki", "Ministerstwo".

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 2 days before date_to. The call fetches day-by-day, newest first, and stops once "limit" matches are found or 7 day(s) have been scanned (whichever comes first).

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: pl_tender_by_buyer
title: Pl Tender By Buyer
